1-ai-engineer.html.name: The AI Engineer
top3: The MCP reference servers shipped 2.4.0 with fixes for six vulnerabilities across filesystem, git and fetch — pin and upgrade any MCP server you've copied from a tutorial.

Agent frameworks are converging on the same safety defaults: Pydantic AI's security release (SSRF, crafted JSON, deserialized history), Microsoft's approval policies for MCP discovery, and a 30-second default execution limit.

DSPy 3.5 drops LiteLLM as a hard dependency but 'changes prompts, defaults and APIs' — and the Spring AI community org is assembling a full agent platform (A2A, AgentCore, decision extensions, MCP security).
1-ai-engineer.html.tag: AI engineering, in depth — models, agents, Spring AI, MCP, RAG

2-dev-digest.html.name: The Dev Digest
top3: Keycloak 26.8.2 fixes 33 security issues — a stored XSS on the login page and a SAML signature bypass among them — so upgrade if it fronts your Spring Security apps.
NestJS 12.5.0 adds payload limits across WebSocket, TCP, gRPC and RabbitMQ transports and lowers defaults (WsAdapter 100 MB → 1 MB, TCP localhost-only) — large-message MERN apps will notice.
Quarkus 4.0.0.CR1, JUnit 6.2.0-M1 and Spring Modulith 2.2.0-RC1 point to where Java is heading — and Go-built tools (Compose, Terraform) needed rebuilds for a CA-trust CVE.
2-dev-digest.html.tag: Java & Spring, Node & Python, career, security and the rest of the stack

top3: Tool: Goose 1.59 — an open-source agent that speaks ACP and defers MCP tools; a good test subject for Spring AI's ACP harness client.
Repo: spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agent-utils (686★) — Claude Code-style file, shell, skills and subagent tools for Spring AI apps, ready for a tutorial series.
